source='''def transform(grid):
    split = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row))
    top, bottom = grid[:split], grid[split + 1:]
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 5)})
    growth = {}
    for color in colors:
        top_count = sum(cell == color for row in top for cell in row)
        bottom_count = sum(cell == color for row in bottom for cell in row)
        growth[color] = bottom_count - top_count
    chosen = max(colors, key=lambda color: growth[color])
    return [[chosen, chosen], [chosen, chosen]]
'''
